explicit_commencement_risk.title: The Andhra Pradesh Residential and Non-Residential Premises Tenancy Act, 2017
explicit_commencement_risk.currency_note: India Code records Act No. 10 of 2018 and does not mark it repealed. Section 1(3) says commencement requires an Andhra Pradesh Gazette notification. No authoritative commencement notification or rules were located in this acquisition pass, so the Act must not be represented as fully operative until that evidence is attached. A 2024 Andhra Pradesh Vidyut Ombudsman order refers to section 20 as the present law; that is supporting evidence, not a substitute for the commencement notification.

explicit_stale_consolidation.title: The Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 (historical consolidation; amendment reconciliation required)
explicit_stale_consolidation.currency_note: This official India Code copy is an old consolidation: its PDF metadata dates from 2008 and it does not include later amendments. MoRTH published at least the Central Motor Vehicles (Third Amendment) Rules, 2026, G.S.R. 48(E), dated 2026-01-20. The principal text is useful for source-family coverage but must not be labelled current or used alone for time-sensitive advice until all later final amendments are reconciled.
